_about: Public-domain George Claude Lorimer (1838-1904), Scottish-born Baptist minister of Tremont Temple, Boston, and in Chicago and New York, for the Word Hoard: The Great Conflict, Temple Themes, Isms Old and New, Studies in Social Life, The Galilean, Charles Haddon Spurgeon, The Baptists in History, The Argument for Christianity, Messages of To-day, Tremont Temple Sketch Book, Christianity and the Social State, Christianity as a World-Power, Christianity in the Nineteenth Century, and The Modern Crisis in Religion. His novels are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 103 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

lorimer-temple-themes: Temple themes. Criminality of intemperance. Preached before the Massachusetts Total Abstinence Society, at Tremont temple, Feb. 22, 1879 (Boston, J.E. Simonds, 1879)
lorimer-social-life: Studies in social life: a review of the principles, practices, and problems of society (Chicago and New York : Belford, Clarke & co., 1886)
lorimer-galilean: The Galilean, or Jesus, the world's Savior (Boston, Silver, Burdett, 1892)
lorimer-argument-christianity: The argument for Christianity (Philadelphia : American Baptist Publication Society, 1894)
lorimer-messages-today: Messages of today to the men of tomorrow (Cincinnati : Jennings and Graham, 1896)
lorimer-tremont-temple: Tremont Temple sketch book : containing a brief history of Tremont Temple Church (Boston : St. Botolph Press, 1896)
lorimer-world-power: Christianity as a world-power (Philadelphia, American Baptist Publication Society, 1899)
lorimer-modern-crisis: The modern crisis in religion (New York, Chicago [etc.] Fleming H. Revell company, 1904)
